verbatim_headers: # ALI-H v1 trace, one row per LIO frame (live and replay). Fields:
# idx rel_s abs_ns grp_idx scan_first_ns scan_last_ns has_out phase eff r_mean r_med r_abs_mean r_chi2 r_chi2w vec6 Ppre6x6 Ppost6x6

#   abs_ns = last_lio_update_time (lidar scan end, ns). grp_idx = capture-time group index (copied with the group, so it is unique across replay); scan_first/last_ns are the header stamps of the merged scan span; join to the bag by scan_last_ns. has_out=0: returned before StateEstimation (Ppre only, update fields 0). phase=1: row produced by a replay pass (timestamps repeat; pair by idx, never by time or row count).
#   vec6 = (state_propagat - state_)[0..5]; Ppre = propagated cov rot+pos block, Ppost = updated cov rot+pos block; both row-major 6x6.
#   r_* are summaries of meas_vec in metres (not a pose covariance); S = H P- H^T + R is m x m and is NOT exported.

#   state order [rot(0..2) so3 tangent, pos(3..5), inv_expo(6), vel(7..9), bg(10..12), ba(13..15), gravity(16..18)]; body frame = IMU/body, cov in body tangent; perturbation: right-multiplied rotation increment (state_ += solution uses the existing StatesGroup::operator+).
trace_layout.phase_semantics: phase=0 live; phase=1 replay, per archive header
trace_layout.has_out_semantics: has_out=0 before StateEstimation; has_out=1 post available, per archive header

trace_counts.count_policy: 1042-style physical row counts include a parseable-prefix truncated final row; missing covariance is never treated as complete

timestamp_precision.abs_ns_original_integer_ns_verdict: Not demonstrated. Binary64 lattice compatibility is checked from values only; origin conversion implementation is outside this task.
timestamp_precision.abs_ns_quantization_evidence: All nonnegative abs_ns are exactly binary64-representable with 256 ns ULP; values are consistent with double-quantized ns, not arbitrary original integer ns.

availability_counts.literal_many_to_one_derivation: For all scan_first=-1 and distinct positive scan stamps, literal matched-row sets are nested by scan_stamp. Rows matching the second earliest stamp match at least two availability frames. These are invalid-span arithmetic candidates, not source relations.
